newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks hover lower, eye U.S. inflation.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks hover lower, eye U.S. inflation.

text.p: Madrid stocks nudged lower at midday, eyeing bond losses as minor profit-taking continued in relatively subdued volume, dealers said.
All eyes were on this afternoon's data from the U.S., with May consumer price inflation seen up 0.2 percent from April, and industrial production also seen up 0.2 pct month on month.
The general index rose 0.13 points, 0.02 percent, to 578.51 while the Ibex fell 25.39 points, 0.38 percent, to 6,601.81
"It's pretty dull, there's not much volume but we think the market's still overbought. (The Ibex) has got a small support at around 6,600," a dealer said.
